responsibility: This file implements the standalone `sarif-replay` command-line program that re-emits diagnostics stored in SARIF files. It parses replay-specific options such as JSON comments, verbosity, file echoing, and diagnostic colorization, constructs `libgdiagnostics` managers and text sinks for control and playback output, iterates over input SARIF filenames, and invokes `sarif_replay_path` from the replay library for each file while handling version and usage output. It is the CLI front end for the underlying SARIF replay engine in `libsarifreplay`.
